newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific edges up on warrant talk.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific edges up on warrant talk.

text.p: Shares of CITIC Pacific Ltd edged up on talk of a warrant issue on the stock, depsite an overall market plunge on Thursday, brokers said.
"Talk of a warrant issue and underlying strong demand for good quality red chips and China-concept stocks had made it (CITIC) a hot buy," said a regional brokerage sales director.
CITIC shares, which topped the list of most actively traded stock by turnover at midday, were at HK$45.10, up from Tuesday close of HK$44.90 and a morning low of HK$43.60.
Volume was 8.35 million shares worth HK$371.94 million.
Brokers said there was talk of a covered warrant issue on CITIC of about 100 million warrants carrying a premium of 14.2 percent and gearing of 6.9 times.
